import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.Radical
theorem p2_n001 (p2v0 : Nat) (p2v1 : Nat) (p2v2 : Nat) (p2v3 : Nat) (p2v4 : Nat) (p2v5 : Nat) (h0 : (p2v5 ∣ p2v2)) (h1 : (p2v4 ∣ p2v0)) (h2 : (p2v0 ∣ p2v5)) (h3 : (p2v2 ∣ p2v3)) (h4 : (0 < p2v1)) (h5 : (p2v3 ∣ p2v1)) : (p2v4 ≤ p2v4) := by
  exact @Preorder.le_refl Nat _ p2v4

theorem p2_n002 (p2v0 : Nat) (p2v1 : Nat) (p2v2 : Nat) (p2v3 : Nat) (p2v4 : Nat) (p2v5 : Nat) (h0 : (p2v5 ∣ p2v2)) (h1 : (p2v4 ∣ p2v0)) (h2 : (p2v0 ∣ p2v5)) (h3 : (p2v2 ∣ p2v3)) (h4 : (0 < p2v1)) (h5 : (p2v3 ∣ p2v1)) : (p2v1 ≤ p2v1) := by
  exact @Preorder.le_refl Nat _ p2v1

theorem p2_n003 (p2v0 : Nat) (p2v1 : Nat) (p2v2 : Nat) (p2v3 : Nat) (p2v4 : Nat) (p2v5 : Nat) (h0 : (p2v5 ∣ p2v2)) (h1 : (p2v4 ∣ p2v0)) (h2 : (p2v0 ∣ p2v5)) (h3 : (p2v2 ∣ p2v3)) (h4 : (0 < p2v1)) (h5 : (p2v3 ∣ p2v1)) : (p2v4 ∣ p2v4) := by
  exact @dvd_refl Nat _ p2v4

theorem p2_n004 (p2v0 : Nat) (p2v1 : Nat) (p2v2 : Nat) (p2v3 : Nat) (p2v4 : Nat) (p2v5 : Nat) (h0 : (p2v5 ∣ p2v2)) (h1 : (p2v4 ∣ p2v0)) (h2 : (p2v0 ∣ p2v5)) (h3 : (p2v2 ∣ p2v3)) (h4 : (0 < p2v1)) (h5 : (p2v3 ∣ p2v1)) : (p2v4 ∣ 0) := by
  exact @dvd_zero Nat _ p2v4

theorem p2_n005 (p2v0 : Nat) (p2v1 : Nat) (p2v2 : Nat) (p2v3 : Nat) (p2v4 : Nat) (p2v5 : Nat) (h0 : (p2v5 ∣ p2v2)) (h1 : (p2v4 ∣ p2v0)) (h2 : (p2v0 ∣ p2v5)) (h3 : (p2v2 ∣ p2v3)) (h4 : (0 < p2v1)) (h5 : (p2v3 ∣ p2v1)) : (0 ≤ p2v1) := by
  exact @zero_le Nat _ _ _ p2v1

theorem p2_n006 (p2v0 : Nat) (p2v1 : Nat) (p2v2 : Nat) (p2v3 : Nat) (p2v4 : Nat) (p2v5 : Nat) (h0 : (p2v5 ∣ p2v2)) (h1 : (p2v4 ∣ p2v0)) (h2 : (p2v0 ∣ p2v5)) (h3 : (p2v2 ∣ p2v3)) (h4 : (0 < p2v1)) (h5 : (p2v3 ∣ p2v1)) : (1 ≤ p2v1) := by
  exact @Nat.one_le_of_lt 0 p2v1 h4
